verdict.rationale: The evidence shows monday.com lets users build and configure agents by defining goals and rules, or by describing a workflow in their own words. Nothing shows an in-app assistant that learns a user's tone, shorthand, or preferences to tailor its output. Manually configuring an agent is an adjacent feature, not adaptive personalization.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output
